notes.title: The game beta version has officially launched.
Welcome to the Lightspeed Squad PlayTest!
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677093/056b207aca37f65f4c1890a796426195cb9bcbae.png"][/img][/p][p]We've decided to prioritize releasing the PlayTest version because the game is still in active development, with many details needing refinement. However, we urgently need your feedback at this stage, which is why we're launching the PlayTest version first.[/p][p]The current version features 8 playable characters and introduces the global collapse factor mechanic, allowing players to customize game difficulty for their challenges. We've also included over 100 items (currently completely randomized) to give everyone an early taste of the gameplay experience.[/p]
